levels.surface: أحمد بن عبد الله بن الحكم البصري

notes: «أبي الضحى» is written twice, before and after the scene; read as one link, since he is the speaker of «حدثنا ابن عباس».
«تذاكرنا الشهر عنده» and «بعضنا» are the scene, not links; «عمر» speaks and acts inside the story, not as a link.
The Prophet is not a link.
